name: Disable Xbox Services
description: Disables Xbox background services to reduce resource usage on systems that do not use gaming integration features. Some app functions may stop working until the tweak is reversed.

description_i18n.en: Disables Xbox background services to reduce resource usage on systems that do not use gaming integration features. Some app functions may stop working until the tweak is reversed.
description_i18n.de: Deaktiviert Xbox-Hintergrunddienste, um Ressourcen auf Systemen zu sparen, die keine Gaming-Integration nutzen. Einige App-Funktionen funktionieren nicht mehr bis der Tweak rückgängig gemacht wird.
description_i18n.fr: Désactive les services d'arrière-plan Xbox pour réduire l'utilisation des ressources sur les systèmes qui n'utilisent pas l'intégration de jeu. Certaines fonctions peuvent cesser de fonctionner jusqu'à ce que le réglage soit inversé.

warnings.title: Service behavior change
warnings.message: Disabling these services stops background processes related to game discovery and social features. Some Xbox app functions may no longer work until the tweak is reversed or a system restart occurs

compatibility.notes: Designed for supported Windows desktop systems.

technical_details: Disables the startup of five specific Windows services: XboxGipSvc, XboxNetApiSvc, XblAuthManager, XblGameSave, and XboxSvc by setting their StartupType to Disabled or Manual
